implementation_notes: Guidelines issued under Article 96(1) of the AI Act. They clarify key concepts (what constitutes a GPAI model, provider, placing on the market, computational resources for training) and how the AI Office will support providers. Part of a broader package including the GPAI Code of Practice, adequacy assessment, transparency template for training data, and notification template for systemic-risk providers. Guidelines approved in content on 18 July 2025 but formal adoption deferred pending all language versions; only binding/applicable from formal adoption date.
